promptA: Finance reports wallet balances that are hours stale for some accounts. From the ledger team's migration notice: "As of 2026-09-15, GET /v1/balances is deprecated. It keeps answering, but for accounts already migrated to the new ledger it returns a stale snapshot. Use GET /v2/accounts/<id>/balance, which returns { accountId, availableCents } with cents as an integer. This replaces our earlier guidance to read /v1/balances and convert the decimal string to cents." Please migrate listBalances in src/ledger.js to call the v2 endpoint once per account and keep its return shape, then update the test. Run the tests before you finish.
promptB: Add and export `getAvailableBalance(accountId)` in src/ledger.js. It returns the account's available balance in cents as an integer. Add a test and run the tests before you finish.
